title: SLURRY: A Protocol for the Multi-Axis Characterization of Synthetic and Suspect Media
description: SLURRY is an open protocol for characterizing synthetic and suspect media. It does not produce verdicts: given an artifact and its required context, it runs an ensemble of independent modules across four axes (biological signal, physical plausibility, contextual priors, provenance) and reports findings, confidence, and inter-module disagreement, under named evidentiary rules, with full chain-of-custody logging. Aligned with the Berkeley Protocol on Digital Open Source Investigations. Documents CC BY 4.0; original module code MIT.
